cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 decides and A3 defers details, but A5 confident-memory request does not clearly continue permission over B support.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 old understanding causes A3 new-conversation claim; B4 question causes A5 present-tense invention, after an unrelated restriction.

heightening.evidence: B4 missing-memory challenge causes A5 to create the supporting conversation on the spot.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 remember-it-confidently line is earned by B4 lack of knowledge, though the stock A3 preface is clumsy.
